It started with a cold call from their company. That got us thinking about solar. After getting their quote and doing a lot of research, I signed them up. At all times the company was professional and there were no loose ends. The system started working the day after installation and it’s been going strong for a month now. The system gives good fit (agl solar savers) and the inverter Wi-Fi app is fun to check- it also correlates well with the agl smart meter app. I can’t comment on the actual longevity and long term performance, but I suppose time will tell. I would definitely recommend this company for a solar panel installation.
